where: #renk Durum renkleri: "Durum zemini yoktur (subtle neutral.1)"; #tokenlar att.*.bg and status.*.subtle; #bicim Çizgiler damga: "(attendance.border), içi zeminsiz"
problem: This is the first real confusion. The status chip background has three different answers. The tokens set att.<durum>.bg and status.success/warning/info.subtle to neutral.1 (#FEFEFF), and #kontrast measures att.*.fg on att.*.bg. The prose says the chip has no background. The live .stamp uses background: transparent, and no CSS rule anywhere reads --att-*-bg. A developer who follows the token file will paint a #FEFEFF box behind every chip on hover (neutral.4) and selected (neutral.5) panel rows. #bicim also names a group that does not exist: the path is att.<durum>.border, not attendance.border.
fix: Choose transparent. Delete the six att.*.bg tokens and set status.success/warning/info.subtle to transparent (or delete them). In #kontrast, replace the six att.*.fg/att.*.bg rows with fg on bg.surface, bg.hover and bg.selected. Rewrite the #renk sentence as "Damga zeminsizdir (saydam); tek istisna yoğun tabloda Yok ve Ret: status.danger.subtle". Rename attendance.border to att.<durum>.border.

where: #tokenlar space.phone.satirDikey = 12; #bilesenler Anatomi Liste satırı: "Yatay 16, dikey 8"; #bicim: "tekSatir 56 · satirDikey 12"; #tokenlar: "Bileşen ölçüleri (yükseklik, iç boşluk) token değil"
problem: The vertical padding of a list row is 12 in the token file and the spacing diagram, but 8 in the anatomy table and in the .lrow demo. The Kayıtlar screen rows use yet another set: 12 top and bottom, 8 on the right (.rec-row padding 12px 8px 12px 16px). The choice changes the result: a two-line row is 64 dp with 8 and 68 dp with 12. The root cause is that component sizes live in two places, while the reading key says they are not tokens: space.phone.dugme/tekSatir/ikiSatir/altSekme and space.panel.dugme/kucukDugme/satir* are component heights.
fix: Keep one source. Either remove the component sizes from space.phone and space.panel, so the anatomy table is the only source, or keep them and have the anatomy cite the token names. Set list-row vertical padding to a single value (8, with min-height 56/64) and give .rec-row 16 left and right.

where: #tipografi: "700 yalnız Kalın Metin ayarında (Erişilebilirlik)"; #erisilebilirlik: "ağırlıklar Tipografi eşlemesiyle kalınlaşır, 700 kesiti gömülüdür"
problem: The two sections point at each other, and neither contains the Bold Text weight mapping. Sans ships 400, 500 and 600 plus a single 700 that has to cover three base weights. The font-file paragraph in #kutuphaneler implies Mono 400→600 and 500→700 but says nothing about Sans. The Bold Text branch of the theme hook cannot be written.
fix: Add the mapping as a small table in #tipografi (for example Sans 400→600, 500→700, 600→700; Mono 400→600, 500→700). Store it in the token file as an $extensions boldText value on each type style, and have #erisilebilirlik link to it.

where: #hareket Süreler: "süreler Azaltılmış sütunundaki değere iner (iOS ve panel)" against the Azaltılmış cells in #etkilesim
problem: The token-level reduced-motion durations contradict six pattern rows: focus (dur.mikro stays 100 ms vs "Halka anında görünür"), table sort and filter (dur.hover 120 ms vs "Değişim anında"), tab indicator (dur.uzun→dur.kisa 150 ms vs "dur.mikro 100 ms"), accordion (150 ms vs "içerik dur.mikro 100 ms"), toggle rail (dur.hizli 110 ms vs "ray rengi dur.mikro") and page change (dur.kisa 150 ms vs "Panel: geçiş yok"). The token file can express only the token-level remap (reducedMotion on orta, uzun, genis and imza), so a tokens.css or tokens.ts generated from it gets all six wrong. The page itself mixes the two rules: focus uses animation: none, but .sw keeps dur.hizli on the rail under reduce.
fix: Make the Etkileşim tablosu's Azaltılmış cell the only rule. Delete the Azaltılmış column in #hareket Süreler and the reducedMotion extensions, or add per-pattern reduced tokens (for example motion.focus.reduced = dur.anlik, motion.tab.reduced = dur.mikro) so the generator can produce what the table says. Under reduce, give the .sw rail dur.mikro.

where: #erisilebilirlik Odak halkası: "outlineWidth: 2, outlineOffset: 2, outlineColor focus.ring (Yeni Mimari stilleri)"; #etkilesim focus, Telefon: "halka bir View çerçevesidir; opaklığı CSS geçişiyle"
problem: The phone focus ring for hardware keyboards is described with two incompatible implementations. Outline props have no opacity to fade. A separate View frame needs geometry (offset, and an inset variant for edge-touching rows and tabs) that the document never gives.
fix: Use outline props: a Reanimated CSS transition of outlineColor from transparent, dur.mikro with ease.mikro, and outlineOffset -2 for edge-touching items. Write it once in the #etkilesim focus row and link to it from #erisilebilirlik.

where: #kutuphaneler Yoklama başarı animasyonu: "Köşeli onay işareti düz View çubuklarıyla çizilir, yalnız transform ve opaklık canlanır"; #etkilesim success, Telefon: "Çizim react-native-svg Path'in strokeDashoffset değeri"
problem: The app's only signature moment has two build recipes. View bars cannot draw a stroke, and #hareket Kurallar names stroke-dashoffset as the one allowed exception to transform and opacity.
fix: Keep react-native-svg Path with strokeDashoffset (react-native-svg is already a dependency for the icons). Rewrite the #kutuphaneler row as "react-native-svg Path ve Reanimated: çizim strokeDashoffset, ölçek withSpring(spring.imza)".

where: #erisilebilirlik Artırılmış kontrast: "eşleme @media (prefers-contrast: more) içinde tek bloktur, token dosyasından üretilir"; #tokenlar lead: "tamamı aşağıda"
problem: The printed token file (248 tokens) has no increased-contrast values, and the page CSS has no prefers-contrast block. Neither the panel block nor the phone's "tokens.ts içinde ikinci nesne" can be generated as described. The 76 measured pairs leave out accent.10 on bg.selected (7,28:1), so "artırılmış olanlar da tcheck.js'ten geçer" is unproven. In this mode danger.fillHover becomes #861116, the same value danger.fillPressed already has, so hover and pressed look the same, and danger.fillPressed gets no increased value of its own.
fix: Add the mapping to the token file as an $extensions contrastMore value on text.secondary, text.link, text.linkHover, border.strong, border.strongOnTint, border.subtle, danger.fill, danger.fillHover, danger.fillPressed, status.danger.solid and text.disabled. Emit the @media block into tokens.css, add the new pairs to #kontrast, and give danger.fillPressed its own darker value.

where: #bilesenler Anatomi Bildirim: "Başlık baslik-kompakt-01 (14/18, 600); metin govde-01 (14/20, 400)"
problem: The row gives only panel type names, and the phone scale has no 14/18 600 style. The phone vertical padding and height are missing ("Telefon: solda 16, sağda 0"). The phone demo (.ptoast) is a single line in govde-kucuk with min-height 56, padding 4 0 4 16 and no title. Stack order and the 8 px gap between toasts appear only in the demo. The document does not say whether the 5 s timer pauses on hover or focus. The swipe-to-dismiss named in #kutuphaneler Jestler has no specification.
fix: Split the row into Telefon and Panel. Telefon: govde-kucuk 14/20, one line, min 56, left 16, vertical 4, Kapat 48 x 48. Add "yeni bildirim altta, aralık 8, imleç ya da odak üstündeyken süre durur". Either specify the swipe (direction, threshold, spring) or remove it from Jestler.

where: #platform web paneli, linear() row: "Aynı süreyle cubic-bezier giriş eğrisi oynar"; #hareket Yaylar: "kalıbın kendi süre ve eğri tokenı kullanılır"; #tokenlar: "Panel ve bu sayfa yayı bu iki değerle çizer."
problem: The document gives two different fallback rules for browsers without linear(), and the page does a third thing: the success mark falls back to dur.imza 400 ms with ease.imza and switches to --spring-imza-dur 350 ms under @supports. No panel pattern in #etkilesim uses a spring, and --spring-hizli and --spring-orta are never used, so a panel developer will look for elements that should use them.
fix: State: "Yaylar yalnız telefonda; panelde her kalıp süre ve eğri tokenıyla oynar; bu sayfa yalnız başarı işaretini linear() ile gösterir, desteklenmezse dur.imza ve ease.imza". Delete the Platform row's "aynı süreyle" sentence and the two unused spring variables.

where: #ekranlar Akış 02: "QR yakalanınca köşeler 110 ms'de oturur"; #hareket Süreler dur.hizli Kullanım: "tarama kilidi"
problem: On the phone the corners use withSpring(spring.hizli), which settles in 282 ms, and #hareket lists the same pattern under both dur.hizli and spring.hizli. The Kullanım column mixes phone and panel the same way: Anahtar (dur.hizli vs spring.hizli), sekme göstergesi (dur.uzun vs spring.hizli), satır yer değişimi (dur.uzun vs spring.orta).
fix: Label the Kullanım column "panel ve bu sayfa" and mark spring-driven patterns "(telefonda yay)". Change the flow text to "köşeler spring.hizli ile oturur".

where: #hareket Kurallar: "Ok tuşuyla gezinme ve klavye kısayolları animasyonsuzdur."
problem: The live tabs (#bilesenler Sekmeler and the panel filter tabs) run the 240 ms indicator move and the content fade on ArrowLeft and ArrowRight. The page script also binds the table cross-fade to the arrow keys. dur.anlik lists "Klavye eylemleri". The developer cannot tell whether a keyboard tab change animates.
fix: Choose one rule. If keyboard changes are instant, place the indicator without a transition on keydown and remove the arrow-key cross-fade listener. If they animate like clicks, delete the rule and remove "Klavye eylemleri" from dur.anlik.

where: #etkilesim list, toast, dialog, success and banner rows, Telefon column: "giriş ve çıkış opaklığı CSS geçişi"
problem: Reanimated 4 CSS transitions run only when the style of an already mounted view changes; they do not play on mount or unmount. List-item entry and exit, toast entry and exit, and the first frame of the success screen cannot be built the way the rows describe.
fix: For mount and unmount, specify entering and exiting layout animations (for example FadeIn.duration(150).easing(Easing.bezier(0, 0, 0.38, 0.9)) and FadeOut.duration(110)) or Reanimated CSS keyframe animations. Keep "CSS geçişi" only for state changes on mounted views.

where: #kutuphaneler Liste: "sabit satır yüksekliği ve getItemLayout verilir"; #erisilebilirlik Telefon: "satır yüksekliği yazıyla büyür"
problem: Fixed row heights contradict rows that grow with font scale (200 percent, AX5). A wrong getItemLayout causes scroll jumps and blank gaps.
fix: Remove "sabit satır yüksekliği ve getItemLayout" and let rows be measured. The existing fallback, @legendapp/list, handles variable heights if the 500-row low-end test fails.

where: #erisilebilirlik Panel: "Yazı boyları rem ile yazılır (px bölü 16; 14 px 0.875rem)" and "düğme, alan ve satır min-height ile çizilir"
problem: The token file stores type sizes in px and never names a px-to-rem step. Every live panel component uses px fonts and fixed heights: .btn has height: var(--h) with white-space: nowrap, .input has height 40px, and tabs and menu items have height 40px. The 200 percent table also says "Düğme yükselir, etiket ikinci satıra iner", which nowrap prevents.
fix: Name the Style Dictionary transforms (size/pxToRem for fontSize, unitless lineHeight). Move the demos to min-height and allow wrapping, or label the demos as px-only drawings.

where: #erisilebilirlik Dokunma: "araç çubuğundaki 40 px sekme ve alanlarla hizalanır"; Anatomi Metin alanı: "Panel 40"
problem: The panel demo toolbar uses a 32 px search field (.search .input height 32, icon at left 10 and top 8) and a 32 px Süz button (btn-sm).
fix: Make the search field 40 px with the 16 px icon inset 12, and make Süz a 40 px secondary button, or document a 32 px compact field in the anatomy.

where: Cover: "Bu sayfadaki her değer Tokenlar bölümündeki tek dosyadan gelir"; Anatomi: "Ölçüler 4'ün katıdır"
problem: 31 product rules in the screen demos use spacing that is off the scale (6, 10, 14, 18, 20, 22, 28, 34): the receipt timeline .rs (gap 10, padding-bottom 18, 22 px node column, node top 6) with .rcpt margin-top 28, the record tag .tagx (height 20, padding 0 6), .st-note (padding 10 12), the Yok and Ret rose chip (padding 3 8 3 6 with margin-left -6), .qr-info (10 16) and .pnl-head (24 0 20). The receipt timeline and the record tag have no anatomy row, so a developer will copy these values. The record tag is a gray bg.sunken chip, while #durumlar calls it "renksiz ve çerçevesiz".
fix: Add anatomy rows for Makbuz zaman çizgisi, Kayıt etiketi and the rose table chip with on-scale values (for example node 12, line 2, column 24, step gap 16; tag 20 high, padding 0 8, etiket-01 on bg.sunken), and align the demos to them.

where: #gece-mavisi Hiçbir zaman: "Kamera ekranı: hedef çerçevesi ve yazılar beyaz"; #platform: "Durum çubuğu simgeleri koyu (expo-status-bar style: 'auto')"
problem: The camera screen needs values that appear nowhere in the text or the tokens: dimming at rgba(26,32,48,0.5) instead of the 0.48 scrim; a 236 px frame with 28 px corners drawn at 3 px, a line width the system does not define; an inverse button variant (border neutral.7, hover 10 percent white, pressed 16 percent white); and light status bar icons. With style 'auto' in a light app, the status bar icons are dark on neutral.12.
fix: Add a camera row to the anatomy: frame, corners, dimming (the 48 percent scrim or a new scrim.camera token), and the inverse button with tokens for its hover and pressed overlays. State expo-status-bar style 'light' on the camera screen.

where: Anatomi Tablo satırı: "Etkileşimli 48, varsayılan 40, sık 32; başlık 40"; #bicim: "tıklama alanı 40 x 40 px"
problem: The document never says which density the attendance table uses (the demo uses 48), and a 40 x 40 checkbox target does not fit a 32 px sık row. For İncelemede and Beklemede rows the Son durum cell is an empty td with no hidden text, against #erisilebilirlik "boş hücrede görünmez 'kayıt yok' yazısı vardır". The document also does not say what Son durum shows while a decision is pending.
fix: Write "yoklama tablosu etkileşimli (48)" and make the checkbox target 32 x 32 in sık rows. Define the pending Son durum (hidden text or the plan's wording) and fix the demo rows.

where: #durumlar Uyarı seviyeleri: "Seviye 1 ile 3 mürekkep ve ikonla yazılır"
problem: The ink and icon for each level exist only in the demo markup: 1 is status.info with info, 2 is status.warning with warning, 3 is status.danger with error, 4 is solid danger with report. The meter geometry (four 10 x 8 px segments, gap 2, empty segments neutral.6, empty segments on the solid bar 40 percent white) is in neither the text nor the tokens.
fix: Add a four-row table: level → ink token, icon, meter fill. Put the meter size in the anatomy and the 40 percent overlay in the tokens.

where: #platform web paneli: ":root { accent-color: var(--accent-fill); } taşır: işaret kutusu ve <progress>"
problem: The specified checkbox (0 radius, border.strong, strongOnTint on tinted rows, hover border.hover) needs appearance: none. The demo uses appearance: none, which ignores accent-color. The progress bar in #erisilebilirlik is a role="progressbar" div, not <progress>. The developer cannot tell whether to use native or custom controls.
fix: Replace the sentence with "Onay kutusu input type=checkbox üstünde appearance: none ile çizilir (Bileşenler)", or remove it.

where: #kutuphaneler panel Uzun liste: "content-visibility: auto" with "ekran okuyucunun tablo gezintisi"
problem: content-visibility has no effect on table, tbody or tr: size containment does not apply to internal table boxes or to display: table. It therefore does nothing for the attendance table this row is about.
fix: Say that tables render all their rows (a few hundred is fine). Keep content-visibility for non-table lists only, with @tanstack/react-virtual as the fallback.

where: #erisilebilirlik: "Renklerin anlamı sabittir."; #gece-mavisi: "Uyarı ve hata: mor ve kırmızı mürekkep."
problem: Violet carries two meanings: a warning (İncelemede and Seviye 2, status.warning #7839A5) and a neutral presence status (Görevli, #652F94). In the panel table the two sit in neighbouring columns.
fix: Either state violet's two meanings next to the rule, or move one of them (for example show the warning as neutral.12 ink with the warning icon) so that each hue has one meaning.

where: #gece-mavisi lead: "renk olarak gece mavisi yalnız aşağıdaki sekiz rolde görünür"
problem: Midnight blue also appears in places the usage map's "nerede" lists leave out: the correct-code digits (status.success.text), the success toast icon (status.success.text), the check icon on selected list and sheet rows (accent.mark), and the check inside the switch knob (accent.fill in the demo).
fix: Add these four places under roles 7, 4 and 5.

where: #gece-mavisi Hiçbir zaman: "Sayfa zemini kırık beyaz (neutral.2); kart, liste"
problem: Six of the eleven items state what is used (off-white page, white camera UI, violet and red for warnings). Read under the heading "Hiçbir zaman", they say the opposite of what is meant.
fix: Phrase every item as a prohibition, for example "Zemin ve yüzeyler gece mavisi olmaz (sayfa neutral.2, yüzey neutral.1)".

where: Anatomi Diyalog: "düğmeler arası 8"; #erisilebilirlik: "Çerçeveli kontroller arasında en az 12 dp kalır"
problem: On the phone, the dialog's two 48 dp buttons (one framed, one filled) are 8 apart (.dlg-f gap 8), which breaks the 12 dp rule.
fix: Use a 12 gap on the phone, keep 8 on the panel, and write both values in the row.

where: #etkilesim drawer (yan panel) and popover (ipucu); #tokenlar radius.popover, radius.tooltip
problem: Motion and radius are defined for the side panel and the tooltip, but their width, padding, colors, type and shadow level are not, and neither has a live demo.
fix: Add anatomy rows (for example yan panel 480 wide, padding 24, shadow.3 with scrim; ipucu on neutral.12 with neutral.1 etiket-01 text, padding 4 8, max width 240), or remove both patterns until the panel conversation.

where: #durumlar lead: "burada yalnız görünüşleri var"; the .desc lines and Durum metinleri help lines; #bilesenler Seçim: "FF, DC, DD ile tekrarda muaf yok"
problem: The section claims to cover appearance only, yet it restates plan.html rules word for word: "Sebep kodu görevlendirme", "Öğrenci işlerinin yazısı ya da kurul kararıyla gelen düzeltme", the 3-day rule for Ret, the Bluetooth and Konum consequences, and the login e-mail contents. The muaf rule also appears as switch help text. This is duplication with plan.html (D11).
fix: Cut every .desc and help sentence that states a product rule. Keep the name, icon, ink, report letter and plan link. Use neutral sample text for the switch help.

where: #ozet Alt sayfa row, #katmanlar, #etkilesim sheet, #platform, #kutuphaneler, #acik 01: "Açılış ve kapanış hareketi sistemindir"
problem: Facts repeated where a link would do: (a) the TrueSheet system-motion sentence appears 6 times; (b) the selection-mark place list appears word for word in #gece-mavisi role 4 and in #bicim Çizgiler under işaret; (c) the panel toast rule (role=status or role=alert, no library) appears in #ozet, #katmanlar, #platform, #kutuphaneler and #acik 04; (d) the date box rule (Intl tr-TR, Europe/Istanbul, "6 Ekim 2026 Salı") appears in #ozet, #platform, #kutuphaneler and #acik 05; (e) "color, opacity and press by CSS transition, position by withSpring" appears in #ozet, #hareket Kurallar and #kutuphaneler; (f) the haptics details appear in #ekranlar, #etkilesim, #platform, #kutuphaneler and #acik 16; (g) the #ozet Token adları row repeats the #tokenlar reading key.
fix: Keep one copy of each: (a) #etkilesim sheet, (b) #gece-mavisi, (c) #katmanlar, (d) #acik 05, (e) #hareket, (f) #platform, (g) #tokenlar. Replace every other occurrence with a link.

where: #kontrast Ölçülen çiftler: "76 çift · hepsi eşikte ya da üstünde"
problem: 26 of the 76 rows repeat a hex pair that is already measured under another name. For example #143065 on #F2F4F8 appears 4 times, #596074 on #FEFEFF 4 times and #FEFEFF on #1A2030 3 times.
fix: Use one row per hex pair, list all role names in the first cell and apply the stricter threshold. That gives 50 rows and loses no decision.

where: #renk Anlam rolleri: the oklch(...) line on each of the 37 role cards
problem: Each card repeats the OKLCH of the scale step it aliases, which is already in the ramp tables and the token file.
fix: Show only role → step → hex; the OKLCH stays in the ramp table.

where: #hareket Yaylar spring.imza: "%0,12 aşma"
problem: The analytic overshoot for ζ = 0.900 is exp(-ζπ/√(1-ζ²)) = 0.15 percent, and a fine-step simulation gives 0.147. The figure 0.12 is the peak of the 5 percent-sampled linear() curve.
fix: Write %0,15.

where: #etkilesim tab: "Eğri ease.standart"; table: "dur.hover 120 ms" with ease.standart
problem: The tab content fade in the demo uses ease.giris (.tabpanel.in). The table cross-fade runs twice at once (a ghost layer fading with ease.standart plus a tbody fade with ease.mikro), so opacity dips mid-way.
fix: Use one fade with the documented curve in both demos.

where: #etkilesim toggle: "opacity (işaret)"; Anatomi Anahtar: "Açıkken topuzda onay işareti"
problem: In the demo the checkbox check also scales from 0.6 to 1, which the table does not mention. The switch knob check's color (accent.fill), size (3 x 7, 2 px stroke) and the 20 px phone checkbox's check size are not documented.
fix: Add the scale to the table or remove it from the demo, and give the size, stroke and color of both check marks.

where: #tokenlar type.*.lineHeight and font.sans; #kutuphaneler panel Yazı tipi: "Mono 400.css, 500.css, 600.css, 700.css"
problem: lineHeight is stored as a unitless ratio and font.sans as a fallback list. React Native needs an absolute lineHeight (28 × 1.2857 = 35.9996) and a single family name, and no tokens.ts transform is named. The panel loads Mono 600 and 700 although the panel scale uses only 400 and 500.
fix: Name the tokens.ts transforms (lineHeight × fontSize, rounded; first family only) and drop Mono 600 and 700 from the panel.

where: #katmanlar Yükleniyor: "Üç kare time.dongu · doğrusal"
problem: The size and states of the loading mark (three 4 px squares in a 16 px box, rest opacity 0.25, lit 1) exist only in the demo SVG.
fix: Add them to the Düğme row of the anatomy.

where: #etkilesim tab, Telefon: "Göstergenin konumu ve genişliği withSpring(spring.hizli)"
problem: Animating width breaks the #hareket Kurallar rule that width is never animated; the panel already uses scaleX.
fix: Use translateX plus scaleX on the phone as well.

where: #tipografi Panel ölçeği etiket row; #tokenlar grid.panel.narrowBelow
problem: The etiket row's sample text is the same sentence as its usage note (filler). grid.panel.narrowBelow (672) duplicates breakpoint.orta.
fix: Use a real chip word as the sample, delete narrowBelow and use breakpoint.orta.

where: tasarim.html as a whole: 85,187 px tall at 1440 and 145,636 px at 390, 26,087 words (dgate). Tallest sections at 1440: #erisilebilirlik 11,632 px, #platform 6,286, #acik 6,220, #bilesenler 6,036. Evidence: review2/c/er1440-00.png, review2/c/bl1440-01.png
problem: Fails rubric D14. Next to Carbon, Geist and M3 the page cannot be scanned. Numbered rule lists sit in a text column of about 420 px under 1,112 px separator rules, so the right 55% of every row is empty. Component specs are 14 x 8 prose matrices. The same facts come back in 3 to 5 sections (MEDIUM items below). Each piece is well made; together they read as a spec dump, not a design system the owner can approve in one sitting.
fix: Apply the cuts listed below. Lay out every numbered rule list like Hareket > Kurallar (two columns) or İlkeler (title left, text right). Targets: at most 20,000 words, at most 55,000 px at 1440, and no section taller than 4,000 px.

where: tasarim-arastirmasi.html #izlenebilirlik. Rows Gece mavisi, Zemin ve griler, Renk kilidi, Durumlar, Dokunma hedefi, Hareket, Telefonda hareket, Token adları, Panelde bildirim ve tarih. Evidence: review2/r/res-1440-izl.png
problem: Fails rubric R4. 9 of the 44 decision rows have an empty Dayanak cell. Among them are the motion decisions (hover only on a fine pointer, press scale 0,97), which show no source at all. A stale group header reads 'acik-bildirim ... bölüm artık yok', yet tasarim.html still has id="acik-bildirim".
fix: Fill Dayanak for all 9 rows, or merge each one into its sibling row that already lists IDs (Gece mavisinin rolü, Zemin and Gri ölçek, Durum renkleri, Dokunma hedefleri, Hareket süreleri). For Renk kilidi, write 'sahip kilidi, 6 Ekim 2026'. Relabel or delete the stale acik-bildirim group.

where: #ekranlar with Röntgen switched on. Caption 'Kalan gece mavisi: 1 birincil eylem, 4 seçim işareti, 8 ilerleme'. Evidence: review2/c/xray-00.png, review2/c/xray-01.png
problem: The black caption bar is drawn inside the screen, over its header. 'Bugün', 'QR'ı okut' and 'BİL 301 Veri Yapıları' are half covered and the close icon is cut. In the very demo that answers the owner's 'nerede ve nasıl' question, this looks like a rendering bug.
fix: Move the caption outside the screen: into .device-cap under the frame, or above the frame.

where: #ikonlar > Boy ve dolgu table, column '24 · dolu'. The .scroll-x box is 544 px wide for 657 px of content at 1440. Evidence: review2/c/ik1440b-00.png
problem: At the reference desktop width the fifth column (the filled icon of the active tab) is clipped. The only hint that it exists is a faint edge shadow, so readers see 4 of 5 columns.
fix: Make the table full width and move the three notes below it, or drop the 16 px column so the table fits in 544 px.

where: #panel lead: 'Bu çerçeve ekran izin verdikçe 1280 px'e kadar genişler'. Evidence: shots/1440-panel.png against review2/h/panel-1920.png
problem: The 232 px sidebar layout only renders when the viewport is about 1,880 px or wider. Kırılma noktaları says a 1366 or 1440 laptop gets this layout, yet the owner reviewing at 1440 only ever sees the 672 to 1279 top-bar variant of the one panel screen.
fix: Draw the frame at a fixed 1280 px and scale it down with transform: scale, as the phones already are, and print the scale under it.

where: #erisilebilirlik > Hareket azaltma item 03: 'içinde --mv: 0 yer ve ölçeği kaldırır'. Artırılmış kontrast paragraph: 'blok --status-word değişkenine'. At 390: #hareket 'time.baslikGecikme' and the curve card '--ease-standart'. Evidence: review2/c/er1440r-01.png, review2/c/er1440r-00.png, review2/c/m-ha.png
problem: Inline code breaks in the middle of identifiers: '-' / '-mv: 0', '--' / 'status-word', 'time.baslikGecik' / 'me', '--ease-' / 'standart'. A developer can read '-mv' as a different property.
fix: Set white-space: nowrap on inline code shorter than 40 characters and allow breaks only at spaces. In narrow cards, put the CSS variable on its own line.

where: Whole page: 443 text nodes at 10 to 11 px. 176 dt labels (Özellik, Giriş, Değer, Bölüm) are 11 px mono, the role-card hex and oklch lines are 11 px, timeline pins and platform numbers are 10 px. The hero says 'Bu sayfadaki her değer Tokenlar bölümündeki tek dosyadan gelir'. Evidence: review2/c/rk1440-01.png, review2/c/et1440-00.png
problem: Neither type scale has 10 or 11 px; the smallest step is etiket-01 at 12/16. The page breaks its own claim, and 10 to 11 px mono in text.secondary is hard to read at 1440.
fix: Map these to etiket-01 (12/16 sans) or kod-01 (12/16 mono). Allow no text under 12 px.

where: #ekranlar QR okut, 'Okutmayı dene' button. Spec in #etkilesim scan row: 'Köşeler QR'a scale(0,86) ile oturur'. Evidence: review2/c/v-scan.png (frame 1 and frame 5), review2/c/scan1440-00.png
problem: At 2x the code is about 105 px wide inside a 232 px frame. Scaled to 0,86 the frame is still about 200 px, so it frames the projector board, not the code, and the capture moment does not read as 'found'. The .cam-heads blobs render as dark smudges under the board, worst at 1x.
fix: Animate the corners to the QR's measured bounds, or size the demo QR so it fills the frame at 2x. Delete the head blobs or redraw them as readable silhouettes.

where: #gece-mavisi: 'durumlar da zeminsizdir (tek istisna: Durumlar)'. #durumlar: 'seviye 4 tek dolu kırmızı şerittir'. Evidence: review2/c/gm1440-00.png, review2/c/du1440-01.png

where: #ekranlar QR okut caption: 'Kamera ana (1x) kamerayla açılır'. Akış 02: '2x yakınlaştırmayla açılır'. Evidence: review2/c/ek1440-01.png, review2/c/ek1440-02.png

where: Tables across the document: #renk (rule only), #kontrast (white box), #erisilebilirlik and #platform (grey header band), #kutuphaneler (box plus a sticky first column drawn with an inset 1 px vertical line). where: #bilesenler > Seçim, help line under the Devamdan muaf switch: "FF, DC, DD ile tekrarda muaf yok; FD ile tekrarda"
problem: The rule is inverted against plan.html#devam (Md.20/5). The plan says the attendance requirement does NOT exist in a course repeated because of FF, DC or DD (the student is exempt) and DOES exist for an FD repeat, a twice-failed clinical course and the Md.28/4 case. The design writes "muaf yok" for FF/DC/DD and "var" for FD, the exact opposite, then claims "Devamdan muaf satırının yardım metni plan.html, Devamsızlık kararıdır." It also cuts the Md.28/4 clause short. A faculty member reading this help line under the switch would mark the wrong students.
fix: Use the plan sentence: "Devam şartı FF, DC ya da DD yüzünden tekrarlanan derste yok; FD ile tekrarda, iki kez kalınan klinik uygulamalı derste ve Md.28/4 kapsamındaki son dönem derslerinde var." Keep the plan link after it. Add this sentence to any copy test that compares UI strings with plan.html.

where: 18 places, e.g. #acik h3 "Sahibin kararı"; #gece-mavisi role 2 "Sahibin kilidi."; role 7 "Sahibin kuralı"; #renk lead "sahibin kilidiyle sabittir"; #hareket lead "sahiple ayrıca konuşulacak"; #platform "kararı sahibin"; #kutuphaneler "sahip onayıyla"; #acik 01, 03, 04, 13 "olumsuz çıkarsa ek iş için sahip.", 14 "krem görünürse sahip."
problem: Breaks D12 (the plan's voice). plan.html never names a "sahip": it speaks impersonally and in the first person ("ben ekipte yönetici rolüyle çalışırım"). In a repository document read by department faculty, "sahip" is review-pipeline jargon that no reader can resolve, and it sits next to a third voice, "biz" ("çizdiğimiz", "kendi bileşenimiz", "tokenlarımız"). Two Karar cells (#acik 13, 14) end in a bare noun and are not sentences.
fix: Heading "Sahibin kararı" -> "Karar bekleyenler". "Sahibin kilidi" and "Sahibin kuralı" -> "Kilit, 6 Ekim 2026". "sahibin izin verdiği ton aralığı" -> "kilidin izin verdiği ton aralığı". "sahiple ayrıca konuşulacak" -> "ayrıca konuşulacak". "Sahip bunu kendi sözüyle sonraya bıraktı:" -> "Tasarım isteği bunu sonraya bıraktı:". "sahip onayıyla" -> "onayla". #acik 13 and 14 Karar -> "Olumsuz çıkarsa karar yeniden açılır." and "Krem görünürse karar yeniden açılır." Replace the "biz" forms with "uygulamanın çizdiği". Apply the same sweep to the research file, which has 103 uses.

where: #kutuphaneler > Telefon uygulaması, row "Yoklama başarı animasyonu": "Köşeli onay işareti düz View çubuklarıyla çizilir, yalnız transform ve opaklık canlanır"
problem: This contradicts #etkilesim row "success" ("Çizim react-native-svg Path'in strokeDashoffset değeri") and #hareket > Kurallar ("İki istisna: ... başarı anındaki çizimin stroke-dashoffset değeri"). A developer gets two incompatible build instructions for the one moment the design treats as its signature, so D13 fails here.
fix: Make the library row match the motion spec: "react-native-svg Path; çizim strokeDashoffset (Hareket, Kurallar istisnası), ölçek withSpring(spring.imza)". If View bars are what is actually wanted, delete the stroke-dashoffset exception from Kurallar and rewrite the success row instead. One of the two has to go.

where: Hero stat tile "Mürekkep #143065", caption "accent.11, yalnız sekiz rolde"
problem: A wrong fact on the first screen. Roles 2 (odak halkası) and 3 (satır içi bağlantı) are accent.9, not accent.11. The #renk accent.11 row itself lists only six uses.
fix: "accent.11; gece mavisi yalnız sekiz rolde (Gece mavisi nerede)", or delete the tile row as proposed in the length finding.

where: #gece-mavisi rule 01: "Her ekranda en çok bir dolu gece mavisi alan vardır: birincil eylem." Also the #ekranlar caption "tek dolu mavi alan Yoklamamı ver düğmesi"
problem: The same section names filled midnight-blue roles that are not the primary action: role 5 (the checkbox fill and the switch track) and role 8 (the 4 dp progress bar). The page's own panel mock shows two filled checkboxes (the header one and Cem Polat's) next to "Excel olarak indir", and the home screen shows the filled progress bar next to "Yoklamamı ver". A developer cannot tell whether a checked box may sit beside a primary button.
fix: Reword: "Her ekranda en çok bir dolu gece mavisi düğme vardır (birincil eylem); işaretli kutu, açık anahtar rayı ve 4 dp ilerleme çubuğu bu sayıya girmez." Change the home caption to "tek dolu düğme Yoklamamı ver".

where: #gece-mavisi > Hiçbir zaman (ul.never), items 1 "Sayfa zemini kırık beyaz (neutral.2); kart, liste...", 6 "Kamera ekranı: hedef çerçevesi ve yazılar beyaz" and 7 "Çevrimdışı şeridi açık gri (neutral.3)"
problem: This is the never list that O3c requires, but three items are affirmative statements printed behind a block icon. Read as written, they forbid an off-white page, white camera marks and a gray offline strip, which is the opposite of the intent. The other eight items name the forbidden thing, so the list mixes two grammars.
fix: Open with "Gece mavisi şuralarda hiç yoktur:" and rewrite the three items: "Zeminler: sayfa, kart, liste, alt sekme çubuğu, alt sayfa, diyalog, başlık çubuğu, seçili ve hover satır (hepsi nötr)." / "Kamera ekranı: çerçeve, yazı ve yakınlaştırma seçimi beyaz." / "Çevrimdışı şeridi ve bildirim zemini: nötr."

where: #erisilebilirlik > Kontrast eşikleri: "Hiçbir anlam alt tona yüklenmez."
problem: This contradicts the document's own definition (#ozet: "Gece mavisi | Alt ton") and its central rule that Var, success and Sunucuya ulaştı are midnight blue. A reader cannot tell whether midnight blue may carry meaning or not.
fix: "Nötrlerdeki mavi ton hiçbir anlam taşımaz; anlamı ikon ve sözcük taşır."

where: #renk tokens status.warning #7839A5 and att.gorevli #652F94; #erisilebilirlik "Renklerin anlamı sabittir."; never-list item "Uyarı ve hata: mor ve kırmızı mürekkep."
problem: Violet carries two meanings: warning (İncelemede, Seviye 2) and Görevli, which is an accepted final status. The two inks are the same family (hue 308 vs 305, OKLab distance about 0.05), and in the panel mock they appear in the same rows (Berk Korkmaz İncelemede, Burak Işık Görevli). That breaks the document's own "meaning is fixed" rule, and the colour-blindness table never compares this pair.
fix: Either set Görevli's ink to neutral.12 and let its work icon carry it (Belgeli düzeltme and Devamdan muaf already share an ink and differ by icon), or define violet explicitly in #renk as "dikkat: uyarı, İncelemede ve Görevli" and add İncelemede vs Görevli to the Renk körlüğü denetimi table. The first option is cleaner.

where: Hero "tek imza anı 400 ms"; #ekranlar caption "Tek imza anı: kare ve onay çizilir (400 ms)"; tokens dur.imza, ease.imza, spring.imza; #hareket lead "Tek vurgu anı"
problem: Two names are used for one moment. Worse, "imza" is a product term in plan.html ("Yoklama kayıtları donanım anahtarıyla imzalanır", "İmza doğrulama"), and the same success screen prints "İmzalandı, telefona yazıldı". A developer reading spring.imza next to the signing code will confuse the two.
fix: Use one term, "vurgu anı", and rename the tokens dur.vurgu, ease.vurgu and spring.vurgu (with --spring-vurgu and --spring-vurgu-dur).

where: #durumlar > Durum metinleri: lead "Sözcükler plan.html'deki gibi"; Bluetooth and Konum cards "Açarsan yoklaman güçlenir; açmasan da yoklaman alınır."
problem: The claim is false. "Bluetooth kapalı", "Konum kapalı" and "yoklaman güçlenir" do not appear in plan.html. Plan says the app asks the student to turn the setting on and otherwise records "Bluetooth yok" or "konum yok", not used against the student. "güçlenir" is also a vague promise that no rule backs.
fix: Either label the cards "örnek metin, planda yok", or use plan facts: "Bluetooth kapalı. Açman istenir; açmazsan kayıt Bluetooth yok diye alınır ve aleyhine kullanılmaz." Do the same for Konum.

where: #ekranlar > Yoklaman kaydedildi, offline variant, step 2: visible "Sunucuya gönderilecek" plus hidden ", henüz gönderilmedi"
problem: This invents a third receipt state beside the plan's two ("Telefonda kayıtlı, gönderilmedi" and "Sunucuya ulaştı", per brief.md section 4). Screen readers also hear "gönderilmedi" twice in a row: step 1 already says it.
fix: Label step 2 "Sunucuya ulaştı" in the pending style (empty node, "bekliyor") with the sub-line "İnternet yok". This matches the swap pattern the document already defines.

where: Dialog "Hesabın silinsin mi?" (end of page, dlg-del-t): "Giriş bilgilerin ... silinir ... Derslerin arşivlenir; düzeltmelerin denetim kaydında kalır."
problem: plan.html#kararlar-hesap-silme says: "Silme ekranı ve web adresi neyin silinip neyin kaldığını, nedenini ve süresini yazar". The mock gives neither the reason nor the duration, and the button note sends readers to plan.html, Hesap silme as if this followed it.

The plan depends on students opening the app with internet: plan.html#devam-donem-sonu says the instructor asks them to 'uygulamayı internetle açmalarını', and the last-week reminder says the same. #ilke-guven even names plan.html as 'Dayanak' for this sentence. where: #dlg-del 'Hesabın silinsin mi?': 'Giriş bilgilerin (e-posta adresi, giriş kodları) silinir, oturumların kapanır.'
problem: plan.html#kararlar-hesap-silme: 'Silme ekranı ve web adresi neyin silinip neyin kaldığını, nedenini ve süresini yazar', and the plan cites this as the condition Apple and Google set for keeping data. The design's only deletion UI says what is deleted and what stays. It does not say why records stay ('devam kararının dayanağı ve itirazda kanıt') or for how long (the retention period, plan.html#acik-saklama-suresi). It also covers instructors only: students have no e-mail or codes, and their local database and keys are deleted only after pending records leave. Built as drawn, the deletion screen would fail the plan's store requirement.
fix: Make it a screen, or a dialog with a 'Ne silinir, ne kalır' block. Per role it needs four lines: silinenler; kalanlar; neden kalır; ne kadar kalır ('üniversitenin saklama süresi dolunca', link plan.html#acik-saklama-suresi). Then the queue sentence ('Gönderilmemiş iş varsa silme sıraya girer'). Add the student variant.
